verdict.rationale: Fellow documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any connector-capable AI tool answer questions about meetings, recaps, notes, and action items without writing code. It respects existing user permissions and gives workspace owners governance over which tools are allowed and which connections stay active. missing for 10: explicit OAuth authentication documentation for the MCP connection, explicit confirmation that transcripts and search are exposed as MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
